subject: Three-way security walkthrough: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test vendor coordination
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Palmer <sarah.palmer@cardinalbank.com>, Jason Lin <jason.lin@secvend.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Dec 2028 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Three-way security walkthrough: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test vendor coordination

Hi Sarah / Jason —

Thanks for the fast responses earlier. To move this forward we should do a three-way session that covers: a short SOC 2 controls overview (redwood side), DPA redline clarifications with legal / procurement, and a 30m vendor-specific pen-test scope sync. That will let Cardinal sign off on scope and evidence expectations while Jason's team can confirm tooling and access.

Proposed slots (all shown in UTC for clarity):
- Option A: 2028-12-13 14:00 UTC (60m customer-facing + 30m vendor breakout)
- Option B: 2028-12-14 08:00 UTC (compact 75m)

Please confirm which works or suggest two windows and we’ll lock via calendar invite.

Attached: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf, DPA_redlines_v2.docx. Jason — can your team join either slot? If you need a 15–30m pre-call to align on scope, flag that and we’ll add it.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Sarah Palmer <sarah.palmer@cardinalbank.com>

Cc: Legal Team <legal@cardinalbank.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Dec 2028 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Three-way security walkthrough: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test vendor coordination

Ben — thanks. Option A on Dec 13 looks promising but our global ops lead (APAC) is offline midday UTC; we really need at least one morning APAC-friendly slot. Would you be able to do a split like: customer-facing 45 minutes + vendor breakout 30 minutes but shifted to 2028-12-13 06:00 UTC (early APAC) or otherwise Dec 14 morning UTC?

My asks before the call:
- Can you confirm the DPA redlines you’ve attached are the latest? Legal will need to see a short summary of changes.
- Procurement wants to confirm estimated duration and attendees for PO scheduling.

I can block Dec 14 08:00 UTC if that is easier. Jason — can you do Dec 13 early or Dec 14 morning?

Sarah Palmer
Director, IT Risk & Security | Cardinal Bank
sarah.palmer@cardinalbank.com | +1 202-555-0199
From: Jason Lin <jason.lin@secvend.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Palmer <sarah.palmer@cardinalbank.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Dec 2028 13:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Three-way security walkthrough: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test vendor coordination

Hi all — Jason here from SecVend (pen-test vendor). We can cover both slots but prefer Dec 13 09:00–11:00 UTC window on our side; we can compress to the 60m + 30m breakout if needed. We do request a 20–30m vendor-only pre-call to confirm out-of-band access methods and scope of the simulated tests.

Quick notes:
- I attached a short vendor questionnaire (sec-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx) with our standard scope items.
- We will not need persistent access to prod; just a short-lived test account and an IPS/IP range to whitelist during the test windows.

Proposed micro-schedule if Dec 13 14:00 UTC is kept (we can adapt):
- 14:00–14:45 UTC: Redwood <> Cardinal SOC2 controls + DPA summary
- 14:45–15:15 UTC: Vendor breakout (scope, quick Q/A)
- 15:15–15:30 UTC: Quick recap and next steps

If we need earlier APAC times, we can do 06:00 UTC but will require our ops lead to join.

Regards,
Jason Lin
Principal Consultant | SecVend Security
jason.lin@secvend.com | +44 20 7946 0123
[Attachment: sec-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 04 Dec 2028 08:01:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Three-way security walkthrough: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test vendor coordination

All — thanks for the quick replies. To reduce churn on scheduling I recommend we split the session as Jason suggested: a tight 45-minute customer-facing overview (SOC2 + DPA summary) followed by a 30-minute vendor breakout. That keeps Cardinal legal/procurement from sitting through vendor-level detail while giving the vendor time to confirm scope.

I propose this schedule (final suggestion):
- 2028-12-13 14:00–14:45 UTC: SOC2 controls review + DPA redlines review (Ben, Marissa, Olga, Sarah + Legal)
- 2028-12-13 14:45–15:15 UTC: Vendor-only breakout (Jason + SecVend ops + Redwood infra lead)

Action items:
- Ben: finalize calendar invite and include calendar-invite.ics and the PO placeholder.
- Sarah / Legal: confirm that DPA_redlines_v2.docx is the right file to review (Ben indicated it is current).
- Jason: confirm you have a named ops lead for the pre-call; if so, propose a 20m pre-call on 2028-12-12 09:00 UTC.

Olga — can you be the Redwood infra lead for the vendor breakout? If not, recommend someone from SRE. I’ll prepare a 1-page slide summarizing the DPA deltas for legal to speed the call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0202

Marissa / Ben — that plan works for us. Confirming attendees from Cardinal: me (IT Risk), Priya Desai (Legal), and Tom Nguyen (Procurement). Please note: procurement requires the PO before any vendor engagement; I attached PO #2345 (procurement_po_2345.pdf) as placeholder — we will finalize pending DPA signoff.

Requests:
- Please ensure the DPA_redlines_v2.docx includes a short summary of the changes at top; Legal doesn’t need to read every line during the call.
- For privacy, we will require that no recordings are retained. Please confirm you can disable recording on the session.

Jason — we can do the pre-call on 2028-12-12 09:00 UTC; please share the named ops lead for the breakout.

Thanks and see you on the calendar,
Sarah
